text: They sent me a letter stating that the documents I provided do not constitute a valid negotiable debt instrument and the refuse to accept. UCC 3-306 states " If tender of payment of an obligation to pay an instrument is made to a person entitled to enforce the instrument and the tender is refused there is discharge, to the extent of the amount of the tender of obligation of an indorser or accomodation party having a right of recourse with respect to the obligation to which tender relates.
